feeds.title: La Carmina Blog
feeds.description: Award-winning Gothic fashion, subcultures, and female travel blog. La Carmina is a travel TV host and author who blogs about alternative, punk, Goth, clothing, hair and style, and Harajuku Japan youth underground culture. La Carmina's mission is to showcase underground and fringe subcultures in a positive light and encourage meaningful, offbeat, compassionate travel.

feeds.title: STEPHANO Blog » Fashion
feeds.description: Stephano is a Houston-based blogger and photographer with a huge appetite. She specializes in gothic and lolita Japanese street fashion. Stephano first started blogging about her alternative fashion style inspired by Harajuku street fashion. She draws inspiration for her dark fantasy gothic style from lolita fashion, ouji fashion, androgynous style, and visual kei.

feeds.title: Bound in Bone
feeds.description: Hi! I'm Darcie. And I'm a bit of a goth. My style is probably somewhere between nu-goth & cosy goth. I love clothes but I am not good at spending money. I consider myself a feminist, I believe trans women are women, Black Lives Matter, climate change is real & mental health is important. My blog is for goths like me!

feeds.title: Bête Noire Blog
feeds.description: Bête Noire was founded in 2017 by Alicia Rau to create a brand that offers classic alternative style for all. Alicia grew up in an exceptionally creative home. Her Mother, Cindy, and Grandmother, Antoinette, encouraged her to be different from a young age. Today, Bête Noire is here to bring alternative style to the masses, while encouraging those of all ages to embrace their individuality.

feeds.title: Stygian Siryn » Fashion
feeds.description: Find Fashion, Lifestyle, and Advice From A Plus Size Goth. Being a plus size means you tend to be very underrepresented in the goth/alternative community when it comes to fashion brands and alt pages. Because of this, there's a lot of questions on where plus size goths can go to find goth and alt fashion that will not only fit them, but will look good on them. I want to help with my blog.
